fact: FHI 360 EpiC Lesotho's June 2026 request for proposal has the consultant coordinate integration and interoperability of project systems (LEAD, Infolink, DHIS2 Tracker) with the national DHIS2 platform, supporting MoH and DHMTs in project-supported districts.
ICAP says NUL co-led DHIS2 training for 518 users from across the 10 districts in 2021-2022, and supports strategic information systems at 205 facilities in 10 district health offices.
